title: Validity, Expiry Grace and Invoice Terms of the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs
content:
# Terms of Sale — Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs: Validity and Invoice Periods

**1. Unit validity.** Units of a Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs pack may be used during the number of months after the purchase date shown for that pack below.

**2. Expiry grace.** The expiry grace is the number of calendar days after the expiry date during which submissions are still accepted. A grace of 0 days means no submissions are accepted after the expiry date.

**3. Invoice due period.** The pack invoice must be paid within the number of calendar days after purchase shown for that pack.

**4. Unpaid-invoice cancellation period.** The number of calendar days after purchase after which a program whose invoice is still unpaid is cancelled.

## Schedule of periods by pack

| Pack | Unit validity (months after purchase) | Expiry grace (calendar days) | Invoice due (calendar days after purchase) | Unpaid program cancelled after (calendar days after purchase) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 18 | 0 | 15 | 30 |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 18 | 0 | 15 | 30 |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 24 | 0 | 30 | 45 |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 24 | 15 | 30 | 45 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 24 | 15 | 30 | 60 |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 36 | 30 | 30 | 60 |

## Points of comparison

- Only the First Notice 600-Unit, 1200-Unit and 2500-Unit Programs have an expiry grace (15, 15 and 30 calendar days); the three smaller packs have none.
- On every pack the unpaid-invoice cancellation period is longer than the invoice due period: 15 against 30 days on the two smallest packs, 30 against 45 days on the 300-unit and 600-unit packs, and 30 against 60 days on the two largest.
- The validity is counted in months, while the grace, the invoice due period and the cancellation period are counted in calendar days.
